summary: The registrant, Forefront Tech Holdings Acquisition Corp, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that effective June 22, 2026, holders of its IPO units may elect to separate them into Class A ordinary shares and warrants. No fractional warrants will be issued. The units, ordinary shares, and warrants will trade on Nasdaq under symbols FTHAU, FTHA, and FTHAW respectively. Holders must contact the transfer agent, Odyssey Transfer and Trust Company, to effect the separation. This is a routine administrative announcement regarding unit separation, not a special situation event.
